# Pals Travel & Leisure

> Nairobi-based travel company, operating since 2010. Plans private, tailor-made safaris in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, and books hotels, airport transfers, flights, car hire, private school transport, events and visa applications.

## Contact
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 757 129 599, +254 722 331 204
- Email: info@palstravelleisure.co.ke
- Office: House No. 128, Nandi Road, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00. Closed Sunday.

## Safaris and tours
- 1 Day Nairobi Tour & Excursion: Nairobi National Park, elephant orphanage, Giraffe Centre
- 3 Days Maasai Mara Safari: based at Sentinel Mara Camp
- 3 Days Amboseli Tour: elephants beneath Kilimanjaro
- 3 Days Samburu or Shaba: wildlife and culture in northern Kenya
- 5 Days Mara, Nakuru & Amboseli
- 6 Days Mara Camping Safari
- 9 Days Classic Safari
- 11 Days Kenya Lodge Safari
Prices are confirmed on request. Sending a booking request is free.

## Services
- [Safaris and tours](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/safaris)
- [Car hire with or without a driver](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/car-hire): safari Land Cruisers, pop-up roof vans, executive saloons, HiAce vans, coasters and coach buses
- [Hotels and airport transfers, air ticketing, events, visas](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/services)
- [Private school transport](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/school-transport): trained drivers, a conductor on every bus, special needs care
- [Plan a custom trip](https://palstravelleisure.co.ke/plan-a-trip)
